plate.title: B14 · Quiet interlocking serif bands
plate.description: The four actual quarter-related serif-I contours remain the dominant pattern and retain their exact colour-selection identities. The overall read adds only a centreline; the intermediate read has one slender bar-aligned leaf per chamber; the detail read has two opposed simple leaves meeting at the bar's centre. Bare caps and interlocks preserve the source rhythm without flowers, cap fans or nested collars.
